flavor.phonemic_palette: Fused Plains-Steppe: open CV syllables; vowel harmony (back a/o/u vs front e/i); consonants p t k s sh h m n w y, kh, ng, glottal stop '; agglutinative suffixes shared by both parents (-tai/-ta, -na, -ai); the fused theonym/lexicon roots sit between Comanche and Mongol forms.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Plains-nomad + Steppe-Mongol per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Plains-nomad + Steppe-Mongol register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'karakan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Karakan — wary clan confederation of the grassland; freedom, strength.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Karakan (Plains-nomad + Steppe-Mongol) are a expansionist clan confederation people seeded in grassland, savanna. They prize freedom, strength, glory, lean toward the military sphere, and field horse_archers, light_cavalry, light_infantry. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, storms, nature.
